body:
## Pull request overview

This PR implements spec-aligned internationalization for CRM metadata by migrating from plain string labels to I18nLabel objects (`{ key, defaultValue, params? }`) and establishing an API-based translation loading mechanism.

**Changes:**
- CRM metadata (app, dashboard, navigation) now uses I18nLabel objects for all user-facing text
- Navigation types updated to support I18nLabel union type alongside plain strings
- Translation utilities enhanced to accept optional `t()` function for i18n resolution
- API endpoint `/api/v1/i18n/:lang` added to serve application translations dynamically
- Console components (AppSidebar, DashboardView) updated to resolve I18nLabel objects for app/dashboard-level labels

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 15 out of 15 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/app.ts | Updated NavigationItem and NavigationArea label types to support I18nLabel objects |
| packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx | Added resolveLabel() helper and applied it to all label rendering points |
| packages/layout/src/AppSchemaRenderer.tsx | Uses resolveLabel() for area switcher and mobile navigation |
| examples/crm/src/apps/crm.app.ts | Converted all navigation labels to I18nLabel objects with crm.* translation keys |
| examples/crm/src/dashboards/crm.dashboard.ts | Converted dashboard label and all widget titles to I18nLabel objects |
| examples/crm/src/__tests__/crm-metadata.test.ts | Added resolveTitle() helper for test assertions on I18nLabel fields |
| apps/console/src/utils.ts | Enhanced resolveI18nLabel() to accept optional t() function for i18n resolution |
| apps/console/src/main.tsx | Added loadLanguage callback that fetches translations from API endpoint |
| apps/console/src/mocks/browser.ts | Added /api/v1/i18n/:lang handler that loads CRM locales |
| apps/console/src/mocks/server.ts | Added /api/v1/i18n/:lang handler for Node test environment |
| apps/console/src/components/DashboardView.tsx | Added useObjectTranslation() hook and resolves dashboard-level labels |
| apps/console/src/components/AppSidebar.tsx | Passes t() to resolveI18nLabel for app label/description resolution |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/AppSidebar.test.tsx | Updated mock for resolveI18nLabel and added useObjectTranslation mock |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/app-creation-integration.test.tsx | Updated resolveI18nLabel mock to handle I18nLabel objects |
| ROADMAP.md | Documented P1 i18n implementation completion |
</details>

The dashboard `description` field is a plain string, while the `label` field uses an I18nLabel object. For consistency and complete i18n coverage, the description should also use an I18nLabel object like `{ key: 'crm.dashboard.description', defaultValue: 'Revenue metrics, pipeline analytics, and deal insights' }`. This ensures all user-facing text in the dashboard metadata can be translated.
```suggestion
  description: { key: 'crm.dashboard.description', defaultValue: 'Revenue metrics, pipeline analytics, and deal insights' },
```

The mobile bottom navigation renders `item.label` directly (line 533) without resolving I18nLabel objects. Navigation items from CRM use I18nLabel objects (e.g., `{ key: 'crm.navigation.dashboard', defaultValue: 'Dashboard' }`), which will display as `[object Object]` in the mobile UI. This should use `resolveI18nLabel(item.label, t)` like the rest of AppSidebar does (see lines 272, 278, 280).

Widget titles in the CRM dashboard use I18nLabel objects, but the `flattenWidgetConfig` function treats `widget.title` as a plain string (line 82). When a widget title is an I18nLabel object like `{ key: 'crm.dashboard.widgets.totalRevenue', defaultValue: 'Total Revenue' }`, it should be resolved using `resolveI18nLabel(widget.title, t)` before being flattened. This ensures the config panel displays the translated title and the saved config preserves the I18nLabel structure when needed.

Dashboard label and description are correctly resolved with `resolveI18nLabel(dashboard.label, t)`, but widget titles also use I18nLabel objects in the CRM dashboard metadata and need similar resolution. The current implementation passes widget schemas directly to DashboardRenderer, which will render I18nLabel objects as `[object Object]` strings. Consider preprocessing the schema to resolve all I18nLabel fields in widgets before passing to DashboardRenderer, similar to how NavigationRenderer handles labels.
